memory_support.text: Remember the rhyme: wave, sing, hop, stop. Each fictional shape pairs one action with one shape.

claim.text: MISCONCEPTION (false): these fictional signs are real driving rules you should follow on real roads.

correction.text: Correction: every sign on this page is invented for the fictional island of Nowhere. Never use them anywhere real.

answer.text: Stop and wave at the statue.

prompt.text: You see a turquoise triangle on the fictional island of Nowhere. What do you do?

rationale.text: The triangle is the wave-at-the-statue sign in this fictional set.

lines.text: Welcome to the fictional island of Nowhere. Nothing here is a real driving rule.

narration.text: Welcome to the fictional island of Nowhere.

lines.text: Turquoise triangle: stop and wave at the statue.
Chartreuse hexagon: sing one verse, then proceed.
Polka-dot circle: hop twice, then walk your bicycle across. Unicycles are exempt from the hopping.
Striped square: the road is closed on Opposite Day only.
Try recalling the polka-dot circle rule, exception included, before tapping reveal.

narration.text: Pause and recall the polka-dot rule.

lines.text: You finished the pretend lesson. Flashcards next: recall before you reveal.

why_how.text: Why pretend signs? So the preview can show the full lesson shape without asserting any real driving rule.

reasoning.text: A hexagon is the singing sign, and one verse is the full pretend requirement.

result.text: You may proceed after the verse.

scenario.text: You approach a chartreuse hexagon on a fictional road in Nowhere.
